instructions: Prepare the vegetables, aromatics, eggs, and potatoes for thai egg with potatoes.
Heat the cooking vessel and soften the aromatics until fragrant.
Add the seasoned eggs and cook it until browned or heated through as appropriate.
Stir in the potatoes, vegetables, and sauce and cook until the mixture is tender and cohesive.
Taste the thai egg with potatoes, adjust the seasoning, and portion it evenly while warm.
